info.title: v2.product.add_kit_item
info.description: Create the kit item by selecting multiple items and setting main component and quantity per kit.

post.description: Create the kit item by selecting multiple items and setting main component and quantity per kit.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: auto_sync_dts
parameters.description: Auto sync the pre_order setting from main component or not.

parameters.name: component_item_id
parameters.description: ID of the item that composes this kit model.

parameters.name: component_list
parameters.description: Please get the amount of item/model that one kit model support from get_kit_item_limit.

parameters.name: component_model_id
parameters.description: ID of the model that composes this kit model.

parameters.name: days_to_ship
parameters.description: The guaranteed days to ship orders. Please get the days_to_ship range from get_kit_item_limit api.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: If description_type is normal, description information should be set by this field.

parameters.name: description_info
parameters.description: Rich text description field. Only whitelist sellers can use it. If you use the field, please upload the description_type=extended otherwise api will return error. If you don't use this field, you don't need to upload the description_type or upload description_type=normal

parameters.name: description_type
parameters.description: See Data Definition- description_type (normal , extended). If you want to use extended_description, this field must be inputed.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: The dimension of this kit item.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether channel is enabled for this kit item.

parameters.name: extended_description
parameters.description: If description_type is extended , Description information should be set by this field.

parameters.name: field_list
parameters.description: Field of extended description.

parameters.name: field_type
parameters.description: Type of extended description field. See Data Definition- description_field_type (text , image).

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Option image.

parameters.name: image_id
parameters.description: Image id.

parameters.name: image_id_list
parameters.description: ID of image.

parameters.name: image_info
parameters.description: If field_type is image, image will be set by this field.

parameters.name: images
parameters.description: Item images with 1:1 ratio.

parameters.name: is_free
parameters.description: Whether cover shipping fee for buyer.

parameters.name: is_pre_order
parameters.description: Whether kit item is pre order.

parameters.name: item_name
parameters.description: The name of this kit item.

parameters.name: item_sku
parameters.description: SKU tag of item

parameters.name: logistic_id
parameters.description: ID of the channel.

parameters.name: logistic_info
parameters.description: Logistic channel setting.

parameters.name: long_images
parameters.description: Item images with 3:4 ratio.

parameters.name: main_component
parameters.description: Whether this item/model is the main component for this kit. One kit item can only have one item/model as main component.

parameters.name: model_list
parameters.description: Model info list, model number at most 9.

parameters.name: model_sku
parameters.description: Seller SKU of this kit model, model_sku length information needs to be no more than 100 characters.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Tier variation name.

parameters.name: option
parameters.description: Option name.

parameters.name: option_list
parameters.description: Tier variation option info list.

parameters.name: original_price
parameters.description: Original price of this kit model.

parameters.name: package_height
parameters.description: The height of package for this kit item, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: package_length
parameters.description: The length of package for this kit item, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: package_width
parameters.description: The width of package for this kit item, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: pre_order
parameters.description: Pre order setting.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: The amount of the item/model that composes this kit model.

parameters.name: shipping_fee
parameters.description: Shipping fee. Only needed when logistics fee_type = CUSTOM_PRICE.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: size_id
parameters.description: Size ID. Only needed when logistic fee_type = SIZE_SELECTION.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: If field_type is text, text information will be set by this field.

parameters.name: tier_index
parameters.description: Tier index of this kit model.

parameters.name: tier_variation_list
parameters.description: Tier variation info list. Only support one tier variation, and each kit item can have from 1 to 9 kit variations.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: unlisted
parameters.description: Unlist or not.

parameters.name: video_upload_id
parameters.description: Video upload ID returned from video uploading API. Only accept one video_upload_id.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: The weight of this kit item, the unit is KG.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/add_kit_item?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "item_setting": {
        "description": "item description sample",
        "description_info": {
            "extended_description": {
                "field_list": [
                    {
                        "field_type": "-",
                        "image_info": {
                            "image_id": "-"
                        },
                        "text": "-"
                    }
                ]
            }
        },
        "description_type": "extended",
        "dimension": {
            "package_height": 11,
            "package_length": 11,
            "package_width": 11
        },
        "images": {
            "image_id_list": [
                "-"
            ]
        },
        "item_name": "item name sample",
        "item_sku": "item sku sample",
        "logistic_info": [
            {
                "enabled": true,
                "is_free": true,
                "logistic_id": 0,
                "shipping_fee": 0.1,
                "size_id": 0
            }
        ],
        "long_images": {
            "image_id_list": [
                "-"
            ]
        },
        "model_list": [
            {
                "component_list": [
                    {
                        "component_item_id": 892568916,
                        "component_model_id": 8501462426,
                        "main_component": true,
                        "quantity": 2
                    }
                ],
                "model_sku": "model sku sample",
                "original_price": 38.3,
                "tier_index": [
                    0
                ]
            }
        ],
        "pre_order": {
            "days_to_ship": 10,
            "is_pre_order": true
        },
        "tier_variation_list": [
            {
                "name": "-",
                "option_list": [
                    {
                        "image": {
                            "image_id": "-"
                        },
                        "option": "-"
                    }
                ]
            }
        ],
        "unlisted": false,
        "video_upload_id": [
            "sg_f4bde9bc-ff3c-485e-a6dd-3161dab4b942_000000"
        ],
        "weight": 1.1
    },
    "sync_setting": {
        "auto_sync_dts": true
    }
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
